messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] inference-api v2.5.0 promoted to prod (canary=10%) — changelist #4821. CI: green. rollout started 2024-05-05T03:12Z. https://ci.redwood/inference/4821

alexa: running post-deploy smoke suite now: /health, /v1/embed synthetic requests, and basic end-to-end flow. will report results in ~5m

devin: seeing a small spike in 502s hitting canary instances — ~1.2% of probes over the last 2m, p95 latency jumped to ~850ms for decode path

marco: confirming on my side, synthetic-probe shows 502 and 'upstream reset' in the decode worker: "Upstream connection reset by peer"

sre-oncall: tagging incident and ASG alarms. I'm going to attach the canary graph and mark for mitigation. Do we want to pause the rollout?

eva: can we pin traffic back to v2.4.1 for the canary slice only? prefer traffic pin rather than full rollback if possible to reduce churn

devin: quick log snippet from canary pod showing KV cache miss + fallback to cpu path:
```
[2024-05-05T03:13:21Z] decode_worker[pid=2345]: kv_cache: miss key=prompt-abc123, falling back to cpu_decode
[2024-05-05T03:13:21Z] decode_worker[pid=2345]: decode_latency_ms=812, err="upstream reset"
```

infra-bot: ASG autoscale: +2 pods triggered at 03:14Z by p95 latency threshold. No OOMs or node pressure recorded.

alexa: suggestion: drain canary traffic to zero and route that 10% back to v2.4.1 while we triage. Then re-run smoke probes. If green, we can re-open rollout after fixes.

marco: applying route patch now — will set canary=0 (drain over 30s) and pin canary slice to v2.4.1

deploy-bot: [route-update] inference-api canary traffic updated: canary=0 -> previous stable v2.4.1 (drain timeout=30s). Change id: route-7721

sre-oncall: re-running smoke suite against stable now. first pass: /health OK, generation p95 120ms, embedding p95 45ms. second pass shows occasional 429s on /v1/embed (rate-limit headers present) — likely synthetic QPS bump from probes

devin: 429s explainable: our synthetic probes ramped too quickly against smaller canary pool after route change. That said the 502/source resets were correlated with KV-cache misses on cold start for the decode path in v2.5.0. We should add a warmup flag in the runtime and document it in release notes.

eva: decision: hold v2.5.0 rollout. Action items: 1) revert canary traffic (done), 2) open a fix ticket for KV cache warmup + backoff on upstream resets (#4821-fix), 3) add model warmup step to release notes and deployment checklist, 4) schedule a new canary during change window tomorrow. I'll update the release notes and ping PMs.

marco: creating rollback/hold PR referencing #4821-fix and a changelog entry. scheduling follow-up canary in maintenance window 2024-05-06 02:00-03:00 UTC. Will also add a canary-specific synthetic script that warms models before probes.

alexa: curl smoke test we used for quick checks:
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" "https://inference.prod.redwood/api/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROD_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":8}' ; sleep 0.1; done
```

sre-oncall: monitoring grafana dashboards. Noting that after routing update graphs look stable. tagging this thread as resolved for the active rollout — reopening if anomalies reappear.

alexa: saved logs and graphs to the incident binder: https://grafana.redwood/board/inf-canary-1715001234 and added notes to release notes draft. closing unless someone needs follow-up. :white_check_mark:
